data.client: Leading B2B e-commerce player in the construction industry
data.headline: We helped a B2B construction company to reach 1200% ROM
data.headline_sv: Hur ett B2B-företag i byggsektorn nådde 1200% ROMI
data.challenge: 2024 and 2025 were among the toughest years for the construction sector, with 2,000+ construction bankruptcies since 2024, reduced investment and constrained budgets. The client needed its website to keep generating stable, predictable sales despite falling demand and rising competitor ad spend.
data.solution: GO MO made it as easy as possible for buyers to convert digitally: improved quote-request conversion paths, direct purchase of bundled solutions via on-site payment, and a more frictionless e-commerce experience. The client doubled its Google and Bing Ads investment in 2025, improved SEO and AI search (GEO) through better category pages and product structure, and ran segmented email campaigns to RAM contract customers.
data.summary_sv: Ta del av hur en ledande B2B‑e‑handelsaktör i byggsektorn nådde 1200% ROMI under ett av branschens tuffaste år – med performance marketing, SEO, AI-sök och optimerade konverteringsflöden.

results.context: digital channels, during the 2024–2025 construction downturn
digital channels generated 12x the resources invested; every krona invested returned more than 12 kronor
client doubled its Google and Bing Ads investment

data.headline: How Gen-AI & SEO Automation Scaled E-Commerce Marketing
data.headline_sv: Hur Gen AI och SEO-automation skalade e-handelsmarknadsföring
data.challenge: A Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer (€10B+ revenue, 180+ markets) was rapidly scaling a new Salesforce B2B e-commerce platform for spare parts, with no historical online sales data and a platform built without integrating marketing and the content supply chain.
data.solution: GO MO delivered an enterprise e-commerce automation strategy and playbook, reusable Google Apps Script and Python scripts, and keyword research plus Gen AI-generated SEO content, meta titles and descriptions for 3,000+ product and category pages.
data.summary_sv: Upptäck hur Gen-AI-driven automatisering skalade SEO-verksamheten och sparade mer än 400 timmar, vilket ökade den organiska synligheten för över 5 000 produktsidor i B2B-e-handel.

results.context: through automation and AI, refocused on strategic planning
optimised content created and initially deployed
Gen AI-generated SEO content, meta titles and descriptions

data.headline: Enterprise Digital Marketing for a Swedish Manufacturing Giant
data.headline_sv: Så använde vi slutkundens sökbeteende för att öka den digitala intäktsandelen från 2% till 7%
data.challenge: A Swedish manufacturing giant (EUR 10B+ revenue in 2023, 180+ countries) wanted to grow digital revenue for one business area in India, starting from a 2% digital revenue share and held back by traditional marketing frameworks, slow decision-making, limited website update capabilities and limited SEM budgets.
data.solution: A dual-pronged search strategy: Google Ads optimisation for immediate visibility and conversions, plus enterprise SEO (50+ landing pages targeting top-10 positions, dynamic content, backlink optimisation including dealer digital support), under a one-year impact-based action plan.
data.summary_sv: Så använde vi slutkundens sökbeteende för att öka den digitala intäktsandelen från 2% till 7%.

results.context: organic action plan targeting top-10 positions

data.client_note: Anonymised on the English page; the Swedish page names the client. Kept anonymised pending GO MO confirmation.

data.client: Top-ranked global leader in advanced transport and infrastructure solutions
data.headline: Data Driven PR Research for a Global Transport Leader
data.headline_sv: Datadriven PR för en global ledare inom transport
data.challenge: A European transport and infrastructure leader (USD 50B sales in 2024, 190+ countries) relied on traditional PR methods that lacked precision in identifying relevant events, leading to missed opportunities, little digital leverage and inefficient resource allocation.
data.solution: GO MO ran a data-driven PR pilot: a prioritised event calendar with online demand data, a comparative analysis of shortlisted events (online demand trends, backlink profiles, branded searches) and mapping of key events' social media for reputation checks.
data.summary_sv: Så identifierade vi nya möjligheter, optimerade investeringar och förbättrade varumärkets synlighet med datadriven PR.

data.headline: B2B marketing transforming you to thought leaders
data.headline_sv: B2B-marknadsföring gör er till tankeledare
data.challenge: After falling sales in its nuclear power vertical, TÜV NORD Scandinavia started a three-year strategic marketing focus in 2015 to reverse a downward trend with new business and build brand awareness, mainly in Sweden.
data.solution: A Pull Marketing strategy built on existing demand and thought leadership ("Wikipedia of our industry"): a new website, SEO content that "owns" key topics in the knowledge-intensive certification niche, long-term investment and continuous ROMI reporting.
data.summary_sv: Effektiv B2B-marknadsföring ger starka konkurrensfördelar. Läs vårt kundcase om hur Tüv Nord på tre år blev tankeledare inom sin nisch.

results.context: via website contact forms; without an internal marketing department

quote.text: Together with Henrik Anderberg and GO MO, TÜV NORD Scandinavia AB has developed a marketing and sales strategy for our operations. … The chosen digital market orientation has shown good impact, one of them is becoming a strengthened brand, and has led to many business opportunities.
quote.author: Anders Egerbo

data.headline: Outbound Lead Generation Strategy for Dell
data.headline_sv: Outbound-strategi genererade relevanta leads för Dell
data.challenge: Dell wanted to increase sales of its hybrid cloud solution by reaching IT decision-makers in France, qualifying leads on budget, authority, need and timeline (BANT) and generating leads able to convert quickly.
data.solution: GO MO DBS expanded the client's list to 9,500 relevant prospects and ran a two-pronged funnel of electronic direct mail (EDM) and telemarketing, following up engaged, BANT-fit prospects by phone.
data.summary_sv: En kombinerad e-post- och telemarketing-strategi resulterade i relevanta leads redo att köpa.

results.context: key decision-makers relevant to the offer

results.period: first three weeks of the campaign

results.metric: Leads with purchase timeline within 6 months

results.context: relevant IT decision-makers for future campaigns

data.headline: Disruptor competes with established actors using SEO
data.headline_sv: Digital marknadsföring för distuptivt bolag
data.challenge: Adnavem, a digital platform for planning and booking sea freight founded in 2017, had to compete with established logistics players whose websites received several times more visitors.
data.solution: GO MO first fixed the technical foundations of Adnavem's website, then built an SEO strategy and shifted focus to traffic quality through on-page and off-page optimisation with customer-first content.
data.summary_sv: När Adnavem implementerade en SEO-strategi började hemsidan snabbt generera affärer trots mer väletablerade konkurrenter.

quote.text: We needed a partner with a local presence that could scale up the collaboration to keep pace with our growth and the maturing market. In addition to good results, I appreciated our weekly meetings and reports …
quote.author: Victor Salomonsson

data.headline: Digital Sales Process Spurred Incredible Growth
data.headline_sv: Digitala processer möjliggjorde tillväxt för säkerhetsbolag
data.challenge: A long-established company selling security and alarm systems to individuals and businesses had no digital presence: it was visible for only a few of ~80 relevant product queries, its old website was slow and controlled by a former supplier, and traditional door-to-door sales were under pressure.
data.solution: Starting in early 2018, GO MO ran a digital marketing analysis and growth strategy, redesigned and developed a new UX-focused website with new content, and continued with SEO, lead generation and development of a digital sales process.
data.summary_sv: Läs om hur larm- och säkerhetsbolaget kunde vinna marknadsandelar genom SEO och att digitalisera säljprocessen enligt Pull-marknadsföring.

results.context: on the client's invested capital, shortly after the new website launched

quote.text: We needed to develop our business digitally but we didn't really know-how. This is where GO MO Group and Henrik helped us in a fantastic way … Their assistance has led to a constant flow of leads …

data.headline: Data-driven marketing decisions in large B2B company
data.headline_sv: Datadriven marknadsförings i industriellt B2B-bolag
data.challenge: New ballast-water regulations opened a large market for Alfa Laval, which needed to reach and educate customers ahead of competitors in an industry with long purchasing processes.
data.solution: GO MO analysed which topics Alfa Laval should own, linked them to key search terms, identified the need to translate local websites, and did on-page optimisation, a landing page for a key application area and optimised product pages; data was used to show management the existing online demand.
data.summary_sv: Datadriven B2B-marknadsföring som lät industrijätten bli snabbrörligt och ta tillbaka stafettpinnen.

quote.text: GO MO Group has helped us with our market insights in this relatively new application area and it has been of great value to us to know how customers seek information. It has changed the way we look at customers and our communication with them
quote.author: Anja Simonsson
quote.role: VP Communications, Marine Division at Alfa Laval

data.headline: How a B2B company stood strong in a digital shift
data.headline_sv: Så stärktes tillverkningsbolaget i en digital omställning
data.challenge: A B2B manufacturer of professional van racking and storage solutions, traditionally reliant on relationship-based physical sales, needed to keep generating business when B2B purchasing shifted to digital channels in 2020.
data.solution: Since 2017 GO MO has run a data-driven Pull Marketing and SEO strategy, starting with a Swedish pilot and expanding across European markets, building digital assets that generate incoming requests in each market.
data.summary_sv: Med en datadriven strategi anpassad efter kundernas köpbeteende kunde tillverkningsföretaget nå 700 % fler konverteringar.

results.context: in some markets; Swedish page says over 700%
in some markets, despite the pandemic
digital sales and marketing scaled with external capacity

data.headline: Digital marketing across several markets

data.challenge: Coor, a leading Nordic facility management company with 100+ services, needed to market a complex service range to several audiences in several languages and balance centralised and local marketing.
data.solution: Since 2018 GO MO has run multilingual SEO and SEA with central master templates adapted by local coordinators, prioritised tracking (contact forms over email/phone), and a transparent process of yearly targets, quarterly town halls, monthly reports and weekly check-ins.
data.summary_sv: Läs vårt case om marknadsöverskridande digital marknadsföring främst genom SEO och SEA i ett ledande B2B-företag.

results.context: inbound deals closed vs deals from RFPs or telemarketing

data.headline: Digital marketing for dental health company
data.headline_sv: SEO för företag inom tandvården
data.challenge: Privatisation and digitalisation have made dental care competitive, with affiliate booking sites threatening clinics that do not own their digital customer journey. The client group, with four business areas, needed new patients online for approximately 30 clinics while retaining its existing patient base.
data.solution: A Pull Marketing strategy combining SEO (search and Google My Business), Google Ads, web development of existing and new websites, reporting across 20+ accounts and overall digital guidance, run through an analysis → strategy → monthly/weekly/daily process.
data.summary_sv: Köpprocesser ändras i alla branscher, även inom tandvården. Kunderna använder digitala kanaler, alltså är det med SEO tandläkare når nya patienter.

data.headline: SEO and business development for global markets by Gabriel Ghavami
data.headline_sv: B2B SEO för den globala ledaren Volvo
data.challenge: AB Volvo and its business areas needed to influence customer decisions in the research stage to win market share across global markets in a complex environment.
data.solution: As a strategic Pull Marketing and SEO partner, GO MO runs SEO audits, continuous SEO implementations (including on Adobe Experience Manager, addressing cannibalisation and duplicate content) and digital business development, and lectured global marketing teams at the Volvo Summit 2017.

quote.text: Gabriel has definitely convinced me of the power of data-driven decisions and the importance of keeping up to speed on how to rank well in Google. …

data.client: Privately owned adult and vocational education company
data.headline: The SEO Strategy That Won in a Market Shift
data.headline_sv: SEO-omställning lät bolaget stå starkt i marknadsskifte
data.challenge: When the pandemic forced education online in 2020, the client's transactional, high-intent SEO strategy was no longer sustainable; communication had to match the market's real-time needs.
data.solution: GO MO, a partner since 2015, rebuilt the SEO strategy around future students' needs, narrowed focus to specific market positions, worked in seasonal themes, and owned pull marketing from strategy to execution while the client's team produced push material.

data.challenge: Companies talk about AI but few know where to begin or how to bring the whole team on board.
data.solution: GO MO runs generative AI workshops and tailored training programmes adapted to industry, maturity and audience, covering use cases, prompting for non-tech teams, pitfalls, governance and AI policy, and hands-on exercises.

data.headline: GO MO Elevated HighFive’s AI Initiative
data.headline_sv: GO MO lyfte HighFives AI-satsning
data.challenge: HighFive, an innovation hub strengthening Halland's business community, wanted four sales- and marketing-focused companies to use generative AI as a tool, not an experiment, without each acting in isolation and stalling.
data.solution: GO MO ran two shared workshops for leaders and teams (where are you, where do you want to be, what is in the way; prompting and applying AI to processes), followed by individual sessions identifying bottlenecks with tailored proposals.

quote.text: This was not a training session. It was a starting point. Now we know what to focus on and how to get there.

data.headline: Streamlining Content Creation with AI
data.headline_sv: Mätbar och märkbar effekt av GPT
data.challenge: The Chamber spent too much time rewriting the same types of content while content demands rose, and struggled to keep one consistent voice across writers.
data.solution: GO MO mapped the writing process with the communications lead and AI pilot group, then built a private custom GPT with embedded instructions, tone guides, terminology lists and sample texts, iterating until it delivered right on the first try.
data.summary_sv: Med GPT blev effekten mätbar och märkbar snabbare texter, högre kvalitet och rätt tonalitet.

results.metric: Time from idea to publication-ready text

quote.text: We save time, we improve quality – and we sound like ourselves. That's exactly what we wanted.

data.client: Commercial property company in western Sweden
data.headline: How segmented B2B outreach generated 15 Sales Qualified Leads
data.headline_sv: Så gav en segmenterad B2B-kampanj 15 kvalificerade leads
data.challenge: A commercial property company (portfolio valued at over SEK 20 billion) needed to build awareness of and commercial interest in available space in a developing business district, where few companies are looking for new premises on any given day.
data.solution: GO MO mapped the ICP, sourced and verified prospects, split them into three segments (Foodtech, HR, CEO) with segment-specific value propositions, and ran a three-email sequence with A/B-tested subject lines and deliverability monitoring.
data.summary_sv: B2B-leadsgenerering: segmenterad outreach till ~900 beslutsfattare åt ett fastighetsbolag gav 18 % svarsfrekvens och 15 kvalificerade leads.

results.context: decision-makers who accepted a meeting (6) or were open to discussion (9)

results.metric: CEO subject-line A/B test open rate

data.headline: A MedTech company needed to fill the room. We did it with the right people.
data.challenge: A medtech manufacturer launching a new platform needed a live 60-minute technical webinar filled with senior budget holders across two markets in four weeks, with one fixed date and a clinical audience that books ahead and cancels easily.
data.solution: GO MO narrowed a ~9,500-contact market to three audiences and gave each channel one job: paid social for reach, owned email and CRM for depth, and a ~2,100-person matched audience plus personalised outreach for precision, all pointing to one registration page with nine tracked sources.

results.context: over the registration target in the campaign plan
distinct organisations that sent at least one person

data.client: Swedish B2B manufacturer of specialist technical equipment
data.headline: The first Swedish B2B website with a full agentic layer
data.challenge: A Swedish B2B manufacturer of specialist technical equipment sells via an RFQ cart on WordPress + WooCommerce with no public prices. AI agents had no structured way to read its catalogue and no safe way to send a lead; Google's Agentic Browsing audit passed 1 of 3 checks.
data.solution: GO MO built a three-layer agentic layer alongside the unchanged site — Read (llms.txt, /agent page, robots.txt, ai.txt, accessibility-tree fixes), Understand (schema.org, OpenAPI, read-only REST API) and Act (MCP server with a consent-captured submit_inquiry tool feeding the existing sales workflow).

results.metric: AI platforms rating the site agent-friendly
Agent components found by every platform

data.solution: A structured, evidence-based audit framework that maps digital demand, benchmarks performance against direct and indirect competitors, and identifies UX and conversion gaps with actionable recommendations.

data.headline: CMOs of the Future: Digiexam, Niklas Borgström
data.headline_sv: Framtidens CMO:er: Digiexam, Niklas Borgström
data.challenge: Interview (CMOs of the Future series) with Niklas Borgström, Head of Marketing at B2B ed-tech scale-up Digiexam, on the skills and mindset the CMO of the future needs.

data.headline: Hotellet som tog tillbaka sin digitala affär med SEO
data.headline_sv: Hotellet som tog tillbaka sin digitala affär med SEO
data.challenge: A small hotel at Arlanda Airport was almost invisible to Google and dependent on online travel agencies (OTAs) for bookings.
data.solution: An SEO strategy focused on low-hanging fruit and owning specific topics and phrases (e.g. long-term parking), multilingual optimised content, UX optimisation and regular publishing on the hotel's own website.

data.headline_sv: Digitala processer möjliggjorde tillväxt för försäkringsbranschen
